from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc1.dfont')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# inflate dataLen to include map, fixed sanitizer rejects data offset+dataLen > file or overlapping? try too large by 1 beyond EOF

p.write_bytes(b)
PY
